page_title: VIL 1-1 GET | Villarreal v Getafe 16/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' Carles Alena (Getafe) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
90+4' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.

90+3' Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul. Getafe have a free kick.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Bertrand Traore (Villarreal) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
86' Substitution. Juanmi Latasa (Getafe) has come on for Borja Mayoral.
84' A substitution has been made. Alex Baena (Villarreal) goes off and Bertrand Traore comes on.
83' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) heads on.
82' Jorge Cuenca (Villarreal) rises above the defending players to meet the corner kick. His header goes to the middle of the goal, but David Soria is alert and manages to keep the ball out.
82' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) will take a corner kick.
81' Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. The referee blows his whistle, Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
80' Dangerous play by Etienne Capoue (Villarreal). Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gerard Moreno (Villarreal).
77' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
77' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Carles Alena (Getafe). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
77' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
75' Carles Alena (Getafe) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
75' A dangerous looking corner kick from Carles Alena (Getafe) is cleared to safety by the defence. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
74' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.

73' Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from David Soria, who tips the ball around the post.
72' It's time for a substitution. Jorge Cuenca comes on in place of Alberto Moreno (Villarreal).
72' Marcelino has decided to substitute Francis Coquelin and he is replaced by Dani Parejo (Villarreal).
71' Here's the change. Santi Comesana leaves the pitch and Etienne Capoue (Villarreal) comes on as a substitute.
69' Wasted effort! Diego Rico (Getafe) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
69' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
68' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
68' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Getafe have a free kick from a promising distance.
65' A cross into the box from Djene (Getafe) is cleared.
60' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jose Luis Morales (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch for Ilias Akhomach.
60' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez is replaced by Gaston Alvarez (Getafe).
60' Jaime Mata goes off the pitch and Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) comes on.
60' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
56' 1 - 1 Goal! Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.

55' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
54' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mason Greenwood (Getafe).
51' Alex Baena (Villarreal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola Rojas no option but to blow his whistle.
50' Alex Baena (Villarreal) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
50' Alex Baena (Villarreal) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
50' The corner from Alex Baena (Villarreal) is hurriedly cleared.

49' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Villarreal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' Alex Baena (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
48' Carles Alena (Getafe) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola Rojas stops the game and makes a call. Villarreal have a free kick.
47' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Getafe.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
45' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes a short free kick.
43' Villarreal will take a free kick. It looks like Jaime Mata (Getafe) saw red with that tackle. Javier Alberola Rojas won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
38' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

38' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
37' Diego Rico (Getafe) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
36' Alex Baena (Villarreal) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola Rojas signals a set piece.
35' Flag goes up against Borja Mayoral (Getafe) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

34' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and drills a good shot to the middle of the goal. David Soria shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop the effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
33' There's an opportunity for Alex Baena (Villarreal) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
31' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Jordi Martin (Getafe) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Carles Alena.
29' Alex Baena (Villarreal) drives a shot towards the bottom left corner from inside the box, but David Soria leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
27' Flag up against Gerard Moreno (Villarreal). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' 0 - 1 Goal! Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:1.
24' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

24' Francis Coquelin (Villarreal) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement. Getafe are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
22' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

21' Alex Baena (Villarreal) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for David Soria to dive and make a save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Villarreal are going to take it.

21' A free kick is awarded from a very dangerous distance. It's situated just a few metres from outside the box. Several players gather around the ball, but it seems like Alex Baena (Villarreal) is going to have a crack himself.
20' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle after Luis Milla (Getafe) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Villarreal are awarded a free kick.
20' Alex Baena (Villarreal) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
20' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
18' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Villarreal will have a chance to score from a corner.
18' Alex Baena (Villarreal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) takes the corner with a short pass.

16' Ilias Akhomach (Villarreal) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. Villarreal force their opponents to concede a corner.
13' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
10' Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul after Gerard Moreno (Villarreal) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Getafe.
8' Jaime Mata (Getafe) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
7' A pass lands at the feet of Jordi Martin (Getafe) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
6' Jordi Martin (Getafe) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola Rojas saw the whole situation.
5' Alberto Moreno (Villarreal) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
3' The linesman raises his flag. Goncalo Guedes (Villarreal) is adjudged offside.
2' Kiko (Villarreal) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
Villarreal will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Javier Alberola Rojas.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
